meta.title: CSE Professional Reviewer - General Information (Philippine Constitution)

questions.question: Which of the following natural resources is reserved exclusively for the use and enjoyment of Filipino citizens?
questions.explanation: The 1987 Philippine Constitution Article XII, Section 3 states that lands of the public domain are reserved exclusively for Filipino citizens. While other natural resources may be exploited by citizens or qualified entities, lands have stricter exclusive provisions. Answer is c.

questions.question: What do you call the introductory part of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: The introductory part of the Constitution is called the Preamble. It states the guiding principles and purposes of the Constitution. Answer is c.

questions.question: What form of government does the Philippines adopt?
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 1 of the 1987 Constitution states: 'The Philippines is a democratic and republican State.' Therefore, it adopts both forms. Answer is d.

questions.question: What is the power of the State to take private property for public use upon payment of just compensation?
questions.explanation: Eminent domain is the inherent power of the State to take private property for public use upon payment of just compensation. This is found in Article III, Section 9 of the Constitution. Answer is d.

questions.question: Who among the following may issue a warrant of arrest or a search warrant?
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 2 of the Constitution states that warrants shall be issued 'upon probable cause to be determined personally by the judge.' Only judges have this authority. Answer is b.

questions.question: A foreigner may acquire Filipino citizenship through
questions.explanation: Naturalization is the legal process by which a foreigner becomes a citizen of a country. Extradition is the surrender of a fugitive, not citizenship acquisition. Answer is a.

questions.question: The right to vote is also known as
questions.explanation: Suffrage is the right to vote in political elections. Article V of the Constitution covers suffrage. Answer is a.

questions.question: How many Senators are there in the Senate?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 2 of the Constitution states: 'The Senate shall be composed of twenty-four Senators.' Answer is b.

questions.question: What is the minimum age requirement of a Senator?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 3 states that a Senator must be 'at least thirty-five years of age on the day of the election.' Answer is d.

questions.question: Which of the following bills do not originate from the House of Representative?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 24 states that appropriation, revenue, tariff bills, and bills authorizing increase of public debt shall originate exclusively in the House of Representatives. Amnesty is not among these. Answer is c.

questions.question: The Members of the Lower House are

choices.a: elected by region and by party list
choices.b: elected by region and appointed by the President
choices.c: elected by district and party list
choices.d: elected by district and appointed by the Senators

questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 5 provides that the House of Representatives shall be composed of district representatives elected from legislative districts and party-list representatives. Answer is c.

questions.question: The legislative power of the government shall be vested in the
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 1 states: 'The legislative power shall be vested in the Congress of the Philippines which shall consist of a Senate and a House of Representatives.' Answer is b.

questions.question: Which of the following may disqualify a person from running for Presidency?

choices.a: He is sixty years old on the day of the election
choices.b: He lived abroad five years preceding the election
choices.c: He has Filipino parents but was born in the United States

questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 2 requires that the President be a natural-born citizen, at least 40 years old, a registered voter, able to read and write, and a resident of the Philippines for at least ten years immediately preceding the election. Living abroad for five years may violate the residency requirement. Answer is b.

questions.question: Which of the following shows the transfer of power should the President be incapable of discharging his duties?

choices.a: President → Vice-President → Senate President → House Speaker
choices.b: President → Vice-President → Chief Justice → Senate President
choices.c: President → Vice-President → Chief Justice → House Speaker
choices.d: President → Vice-President → House Speaker → Senate President

questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 7 provides that in case of death, permanent disability, removal from office, or resignation of the President, the Vice-President shall become President. If both are unable, the Senate President or House Speaker shall act as President. The order is VP, then Senate President, then House Speaker. Answer is a.

questions.question: A member of the Supreme Court

choices.a: must have been for fifteen years or more, a judge of a lower court
choices.b: must have been for ten years, a judge of the Court of Appeals
choices.c: may not be a member of the Philippine Bar

questions.explanation: Article VIII, Section 7 requires that a member of the Supreme Court be a natural-born citizen, at least 40 years old, and have been for fifteen years or more a judge of a lower court or engaged in the practice of law in the Philippines. Answer is a.

questions.question: The Supreme Court is composed of

choices.a: a Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices
choices.b: two Chief Justices and fourteen Associate Justices
choices.c: a Chief Justice and twelve Associate Justices
choices.d: a Chief Justice and an indefinite number of Associate Justices

questions.explanation: Article VIII, Section 4 states: 'The Supreme Court shall be composed of a Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices.' Answer is a.

questions.question: Which of the following is a Constitutional Commission?
questions.explanation: Article IX (A) of the Constitution establishes three Constitutional Commissions: the Civil Service Commission, the Commission on Elections, and the Commission on Audit. The Commission on Human Rights is also constitutional but created under Article XIII. Civil Service Commission is correct. Answer is c.

questions.question: What branch of government has the sole right to initiate all cases of impeachment?
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 3(2) states: 'The House of Representatives shall have the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment.' Answer is c.

questions.question: Which of the following is not removable from office by impeachment?
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 2 lists impeachable officials: the President, Vice-President, members of the Supreme Court, members of Constitutional Commissions, and the Ombudsman. Senators are not impeachable; they are tried by the Senate. Answer is d.

questions.question: The national language of the Philippines is
questions.explanation: Article XIV, Section 6 states: 'The national language of the Philippines is Filipino.' Answer is d.

questions.question: Who may propose any amendment to, or revision of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article XVII, Section 1 states amendments or revisions may be proposed by: (1) Congress upon a vote of three-fourths of all its members, or (2) a Constitutional Convention. Answer is a.

questions.question: What tax is paid by individuals who derive compensation income?
questions.explanation: Income tax is imposed on income derived from compensation, business, or profession. Answer is c.

questions.question: When is the deadline for filing income tax returns for every taxable year?
questions.explanation: Under the National Internal Revenue Code, the deadline for filing annual income tax returns is April 15 of each year. Answer is a.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about taxes?

choices.b: It is payable both in cash and in kind
choices.d: It is based on one's desire to pay

questions.explanation: Taxes are enforced proportional contributions levied by the State to support government functions. It is not voluntary. Answer is c.

questions.question: What tax is imposed on one's right to transmit property at death, and is measured by the value of the property?
questions.explanation: Estate tax is imposed on the transfer of property from a deceased person to their heirs. Donor's tax applies to inter vivos gifts. Answer is d.

questions.question: Which of the following is classified as being a 'Head of the Family' for income tax purposes?
questions.explanation: Under the Tax Code, a 'Head of the Family' is an unmarried or legally separated individual with one or more dependents. Answer is b.

questions.question: What Act implements the mandate for the 'State to make essential goods, health and other social services available to all the people at affordable cost'?
questions.explanation: The Generics Act (Republic Act No. 6675) promotes the use of generic medicines to make healthcare more affordable. Answer is b.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about elective local officials?

choices.a: The term of office is three years
choices.b: Barangay officials' term of office is indefinite
choices.c: An official may be reelected indefinitely
choices.d: An official may not serve for less than three terms

questions.explanation: Under the Local Government Code, elective local officials have a term of three years. Barangay officials also have three-year terms. Answer is a.

questions.question: What may be classified as alienable lands of the public domain?
questions.explanation: Article XII, Section 3 classifies lands of the public domain into agricultural, forest or timber, mineral lands, and national parks. Only agricultural lands may be alienable (subject to private ownership). Answer is d.

questions.question: What is the maximum equity for aliens in a corporation or association in the exploration, development, and utilization of natural resources?
questions.explanation: Article XII, Section 2 states that in the exploration, development, and utilization of natural resources, the participation of foreign investors shall be limited to 40% of the capital. Answer is b.
